programmes.d: Suffering post-traumatic stress after being molested as a child, Mindie developed a drug habit in her teens that gave way to full-on meth addiction in her 20s.
At 53, Gloria prides herself on being a good cook and an independent, fun-loving woman. But Gloria uses her cooking and charm to manipulate her family into letting her drink as much as she wants.
While still a child, Zach's father was incarcerated, and Zach and his sister were adopted by their loving grandparents.
He was once a championship bodybuilder and successful property owner. But when he turned 30, Derek felt he was over the hill and became severely depressed.
Dawn, 49, was once a model, but today she's homeless and wanders around town using meth and suffering from the effects of Meth Psychosis.
Amy and her family escaped the violence of apartheid-era South Africa and immigrated to Canada 22 years ago.

Julie, now 40, has often turned to food and alcohol to find comfort in difficult times. She underwent gastric bypass surgery when her weight skyrocketed, but now she spends her child support money on beer and 90-proof mint schnapps.
Gabe and Allison return to tell their stories after they both face interventions and treatment. Gabe used heroin to deal with the deep emotional scars caused by his adoption.
John is a flight attendant who loves his job, but his lifestyle is fueling his alcoholism. When he was a boy, John's parents focused their attention on his mentally disabled brother.
Raised by an absentee alcoholic father, Jimmy joined a gang at 13 and was soon addicted to heroin.
Brittany once dreamed of becoming a police officer to protect people from the traumas that she faced as a child.
A successful businesswoman who became a multimillionaire in her 20s, Kacy tragically lost her infant child to SIDS.
When Skyler was a kid, his mother pushed him to do modeling and TV work, but the tension drove Skyler to drugs.
As a child, Sam was bright, artistic and outgoing. A fast downward spiral into heroin followed and today Sam is a full-blown addict. Her family is hoping an intervention will lead to treatment.
Chuckie, 28, is the son of a famous musician, and was born into the rock 'n' roll world of the 70's. Surrounded by famous musicians and privilege all his life.
When Amber was molested as a young child, she bottled up her emotions.
In this follow-up episode, we look at how two people have fared since their interventions. Ryan, an OxyContin addict, was in and out of treatment for months before dropping out.
